{{Quote|That's Myahh, former first lieutenant of the Endar Rebirth, the first scout vessel sent here to evaluate the possibility of recolonization. Ship disappeared five years ago.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bhoenn]]|<ref name="Operation Salvage" />}}
The '''''Endar Rebirth''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] survey vessel in service during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was the first ship to investigate [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Destruction of Taris|devastated by orbital bombardment]] three centuries previous, as a candidate for [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|resettlement by the Republic]].

The ship was later destroyed over Taris, with only a handful of its crew escaping to the planet below. The survivors lived in the wilderness for five years before being rescued by Republic agents.<ref name="Operation Salvage" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Endar Rebirth'' was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', serving as part of the backstory for a quest on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. No details concerning the vessel's class or history beyond its destruction were given.<ref name="Operation Salvage" />
